effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.
qualifications: The exponent h(t) is finite and nonnegative.
There is a computable function T such that h(t) ≤ η max(t, 1) whenever t ≥ T(η), for each positive rational η.
The proof also permits the solver to receive the exact width and an optimal path decomposition, counted in the complete input length.
